prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: project website editorial photograph
Primary request: a designer's desk viewed directly overhead with abstract printed references, blue color swatches, a sketchbook and small ceramic objects.
Scene/backdrop: calm pale warm desk surface arranged as an authentic creative workspace.
Style/medium: realistic editorial still-life photography, subtle texture, thoughtfully arranged but natural.
Composition/framing: horizontal 4:3 landscape photograph, straight overhead view with clear spaces between the references, swatches, open sketchbook and ceramics; no people.
Lighting/mood: soft daylight, quiet creative concentration.
Color palette: pale warm neutrals, restrained shades of blue.
Materials/textures: matte printed paper, blue paper swatches, sketchbook paper, small tactile ceramics.
Constraints: printed references and sketchbook contain only abstract imagery or nonverbal sketch marks. No readable text, logos, UI, collage layout, frames, watermarks or visible text; one coherent photographed desk.
